module: Texture quality presets, consumed by graphicsQualityGroup. Each level sets $pref::Video::textureReductionLevel and $pref::Reflect::refractTexScale. The onApply hook reloads the textures.
notes: The code notes that reloadTextures() can be a slow operation.

onApply.desc: Called by graphicsQualityGroup when a value has changed. Calls reloadTextures().
